security_audit.summary: Most external-command detections are Markdown formatting, examples, or inline paths and are false positives. The scaffolding block executes filesystem commands and can overwrite the wrong SKILL.md through relative paths. Manual review found no prompt injection in the three templates, but their placeholder frontmatter prevents static parsing.

remediation.issue: The scaffold workflow moves a temporary file to relative SKILL.md and then edits that file.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve the generated destination first, create the temporary file beside it, and atomically replace only that destination.

remediation.issue: Scaffold commands interpolate project names, template names, and target paths without validation or consistent quoting.
remediation.suggestion: Allowlist template names, validate project names, quote every path, and replace sed interpolation with a structured templating step.

remediation.issue: Placeholder names make the three template frontmatter blocks invalid before generation.
remediation.suggestion: Use valid quoted placeholder values and validate every template before packaging.

content.user_title: Analyze Your Stack and Recommend Skills
content.value_statement: Project teams may miss relevant AI development skills for their frameworks and workflows. This skill maps detected technologies to recommendations and optional project templates.
actual_capabilities: Uses library-detection results to identify languages, frameworks, databases, testing tools, and build tools.
Matches detected files and dependencies against configurable skill activation rules.
Ranks recommendations with high, medium, and low priorities.
Produces a Markdown report with detected technologies, recommendations, reasons, and activation status.
Can scaffold research, domain, and testing skill templates and track generated files in a manifest.
limitations: Depends on the separate library-detection skill for stack discovery.
Recommendation quality depends on file and dependency rules in the bundled configuration.
Scaffolding changes repository files and should require explicit review before execution.
The configured project-api template is not included in this package.

use_cases.title: Audit an Existing Repository
use_cases.description: Review detected technologies and receive evidence-based skill recommendations before changing the project.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team AI Skills
use_cases.description: Compare repositories against shared recommendation rules and identify consistent development guidance.

use_cases.title: Bootstrap Project Guidance
use_cases.description: Plan project-specific research, domain, and testing skills with tracked output paths.

prompt_templates.title: List Recommendations
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this repository's detected stack and list recommended generic skills. Do not change files.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Rule Matches
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare detected dependencies and paths with recommendation rules. Explain each match and flag uncertain recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Project Scaffolds
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a scaffold plan for research, domain, and testing skills. Show target paths and required customizations without writing files.

prompt_templates.title: Review Full Activation Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Rank recommendations, identify missing templates, and propose a reviewed manifest update. Require confirmation before every repository change.

output_examples.input: Analyze a Next.js project using Supabase and Vitest.
output: Detected React, Next.js, Supabase, and Vitest.
Recommended react-patterns and supabase-patterns with matching dependency evidence.

output_examples.input: Plan a domain skill for a project with twelve model files.
output: Project-domain qualifies because more than five model files were found.
No files were created because confirmation was not provided.

best_practices: Run report-only analysis before enabling activation or scaffolding.
Review every detection match and remove recommendations unsupported by repository evidence.
Commit or back up repository changes before creating project-specific skills.
anti_patterns: Do not scaffold templates before reviewing target paths and generated names.
Do not trust recommendations when detection evidence is missing or stale.
Do not run shell examples with unvalidated project names or target paths.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It uses detected languages, frameworks, databases, test tools, build tools, files, and dependencies to match recommendation rules.

faq.question: Does it detect the stack independently?
faq.answer: No. It depends on the separate library-detection skill for initial stack discovery.

faq.question: Does it modify repository files?
faq.answer: Report-only use does not. Scaffolding can create skills and update a generated manifest after confirmation.

faq.question: Which generic skills can it recommend?
faq.answer: Rules cover BAML, Supabase, schema alignment, tree-sitter, security, MCP, FastAPI, and React skills.

faq.question: Where are generated skills stored?
faq.answer: Project-specific skills use .claude/skills/, while _generated.json records created paths and cleanup information.

faq.question: Can generated files be removed?
faq.answer: Yes. Review the generated manifest, confirm each path, and remove files that are no longer needed.
